I read the complete held EO 13044 (62 FR 19665, April 18, 1997): three textual edits to EO 12752 of Feb. 25, 1991 (the first sentence of sec. 1(a) gains 'and private entities'; secs. 4(a) and (c) are deleted; the remaining sec. 4 paragraphs are renumbered). Whether it is current depends on EO 12752's own fate (later food-aid executive orders or statutes may have replaced it), and I hold neither EO 12752 nor anything later.
